decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's existing machinery, engineering, service and customer-adaptation capabilities, so management can use its in-house R&D to learn and improve rather than withdraw it quickly.
As an adjacent construction dumper, it fits the firm's established knowledge base and should be easier to refine, support and sell through existing channels in a growing industry.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is distant from the firm's established offer, management is less able to interpret early market feedback and is more likely to reallocate resources despite having its own R&D.

This compact telescopic loader line is close to the core business and already spans several models, which suggests a strong platform commitment and high potential for cumulative learning and improvement.
